meaning:
δια-σώζω
[in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע, etc. ;]
to bring safely through a danger: Luk.7:3, Act.27:43; before πρός, Act.23:24. Pass., to come safe through: Act.28:1; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Act.27:44; ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, Act.28:4; δι᾽ ὕδατος, 1Pe.3:20; of sickness, to recover: Mat.14:36.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
He asked them to provide animals, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved…
